# Tailwind browser runtime

`tailwind-3.4.17.js` is the unmodified browser runtime from
https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17 (downloaded 2026-10-02).

SHA-256: `176e894661aa9cdc9a5cba6c720044cbbf7b8bd80d1c9a142a7c24b1b6c50d15`.

Tailwind CSS is MIT licensed; see `tailwind-3.4.17.LICENSE.txt` and the bundled
third-party notices retained inside the script. This local copy preserves
SullyOS's runtime-generated classes and user-provided decorations while making
the app shell independent of the CDN. It still compiles styles in the browser;
this is not a migration to build-time Tailwind CSS.
